lines.text: Jesus tells Pergamum He knows they live where the throne of Satan sits, yet they hold fast to His name.
Jesus says some in Pergamum hold to Balaam's teaching and the Nicolaitans' teaching, and He tells them to repent.
Jesus promises the one who overcomes the hidden manna and a white stone inscribed with the Ten Commandments.
Jesus tells Thyatira He knows their deeds, but they tolerate Jezebel, who misleads His servants and is unwilling to repent.
The one who overcomes will rule the nations with an iron scepter, with authority Jesus received from King David.
